div.div: A drawing becomes a published floor plan in eight steps. Bookings depend on the stable key of each desk, room and bay, not on the drawing, so every change to that inventory is matched, reviewed and published before it takes effect. Geometry only has to look right; the bookable inventory has to be right.

switch.text: A drawing becomes a published floor plan in eight steps. Bookings depend on the stable key of each desk, room and bay, not on the drawing, so every change to that inventory is matched, reviewed and published before it takes effect. Geometry only has to look right; the bookable inventory has to be right.
